title: Refresh /how-long-does-nicotine-stay-in-your-system for "how long does nicotine stay in your system" (49,500 a month, page unranked)
body:
URL: /how-long-does-nicotine-stay-in-your-system
Cluster: how long does nicotine stay in your system
Type: refresh
Source: Keyword Planner US 2026-11-09, GSC 2026-10-10..2026-11-06, inventory 2026-11-09

## Evidence
- Keyword Planner US (monthly): "how long does nicotine stay in your system" 49,500 (LOW competition), "how long does it take nicotine to leave your system" 12,100. Close variants share volume, so read this as one cluster.
- GSC: 1 impression at position 46 in the window; the prior window had 2 impressions at 6.5. The page has no real visibility for the biggest nicotine query this site targets.
- Inventory: 1,125 words, 6 FAQs, last modified 2026-10-13, no flagged issues, 0 App Store clicks recorded.
- Fit: readers searching this are often quitting or about to take a nicotine test. The same intent has a natural bridge to withdrawal timelines.

## Recommended action
Check the live SERP for the answer pattern (blood, saliva, urine, hair, cotinine detection windows) and make the first 2-4 sentences answer by test type. Add a sourced table of detection windows (NHS, CDC, MedlinePlus or a peer-reviewed paper), a section on pouches and vapes, and links to /nicotine-withdrawal-timeline and /quit-smoking-timeline. Add an InlineAppCta after the first section. Risk note: the page is already live and indexed; keep the URL and H1 intent, and do not claim the app speeds nicotine clearance or helps pass a test.

## Next skill
seo-content-brief

## Done when
Page covers every test type with sourced windows, passes seo:qa, and shows 100+ impressions per 28 days within 6 weeks of publishing.

title: New page: /quit-smoking-medication, an overview of quit smoking medication options (8,100 a month)
body:
URL: /quit-smoking-medication
Cluster: quit smoking medication options
Type: new-content
Source: Keyword Planner US 2026-11-09, GSC 2026-10-10..2026-11-06, inventory 2026-11-09

## Evidence
- Keyword Planner US (monthly): "smoking cessation medication" 8,100 (MEDIUM), "quit smoking medication" 5,400, "quit smoking aids" 9,900 (HIGH). Variants share volume, so treat as one cluster of about 8,000 to 10,000.
- Inventory: no page covers the overview. Single-product pages exist for patch, gum, lozenge, varenicline and bupropion (BLO-28 to BLO-31, BLO-42), and /nicotine-patch-vs-gum is thin. No GSC impressions for this intent yet.
- Fit: topic priority 3 in seo/blou-profile.md. The overview is the hub the single-product pages should link up to and down from.

## Recommended action
Write a plain-language comparison of the seven FDA-approved options (patch, gum, lozenge, inhaler, nasal spray, varenicline, bupropion) with a table of how each works, who it suits and what to ask a clinician. Use CDC, NCI, FDA, Smokefree.gov and NHS as sources. Link down to each single-product page and to /nrt-and-quit-smoking-app. Say Blou is not medication and does not replace a doctor. Never advise starting or stopping a prescription. Medical-claim risk is high, so every figure needs a citation.

## Next skill
seo-content-brief

## Done when
Page published with every claim sourced, internal links in both directions with the single-product pages, and QA PASS.

Blou must not be ranked first by default. Risk note: the page is the only one ranking for the cluster; keep the title keyword, and only change the title if the refresh shows it is clearly weak.

Competitor facts re-verified and dated, QA PASS, and the page returns to position 30 or better within 8 weeks.

title: New page: /does-hypnosis-help-quit-smoking (5,400 a month, evidence is weak so write it honestly)
body:
URL: /does-hypnosis-help-quit-smoking
Cluster: does hypnosis help you quit smoking
Type: new-content
Source: Keyword Planner US 2026-11-09, GSC 2026-10-10..2026-11-06, inventory 2026-11-09

## Evidence
- Keyword Planner US (monthly): "quit smoking hypnosis" 5,400 (MEDIUM), "quit smoking hypnosis free" 390.
- Inventory: no page covers hypnosis. The SERP is likely commercial hypnotherapy providers and apps; check before briefing.
- Fit: medium. Readers are active quitters, but the evidence base is thin, and the profile bans unsourced medical claims.

## Recommended action
Only brief this if the SERP shows room for a neutral, evidence-first answer. Cite the Cochrane review of hypnotherapy for smoking cessation and NCI or NHS guidance, say plainly what is and is not known, and list evidence-based options to try first (link to the medication overview and behavioral support). Do not claim Blou includes hypnosis and do not claim hypnosis works. Medical-claim risk adds 2 to the score.

## Next skill
seo-content-brief

## Done when
Page published with sourced evidence statements, no efficacy claims beyond sources, QA PASS.
